notes.title: New item, change and fix - Migration UE 5.3.2 - Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
This update includes graphic and control changes. I recommend that you check and adjust your settings.

Fix

 Writing spot at the campsite
 Translate
 Collision Little House
 Avatar optimization (Lucia).


Controls

 Shield key "X"
 Journal key "TAB"
 Quick access wheel disappears.
 Alt + Scroll mouse selects a hand-held object.
 Sentences" tool can be used with a hand-held object.
 The controller (controls) have been updated.


Change

 The chances of getting a challenge are greater.
 Journal : Entity visibility, proof and selected behavior are enhanced.
 The object shot no longer increases activity during the hunt.
 Bullet Pistol, Shotgun, Burning Flash destroy the shield.
 The photo of the magnets is permanent when the clue is revealed.


New

 Add a new equipment
 A tooltip is added when an object is selected. This feature can be disabled in the parameters.
 Add ambient sound outside the tormented house.
 Add a new photo to the collection
 Optimization of several items.
 Improved photo quality.


Migration to the latest version of Unreal Engine (5.3.2).
The game remains in an ultra-light package (approx. 6.5 GB) for 10 maps. 

This is a Ghost celebrates its first year!

I'd like to take this opportunity to thank the entire community, and in particular the Discord community, for helping the game evolve with your suggestions, bug reports, and discussions, all of which I never fail to read. 
Thank you all so much!

History

 +80 update :
 5 new maps
 8 new entities
 Random mode, challenge, new quests
 Step by step tutorial
 +50 new photos
 New items (Ouija, Book, Bobby & Zacky, Ghost Tracker, and SPIES)
 New interaction items
 Numerous changes and balancing
 New animations
 Rework of main stuff (LSS, sensor, ghost printer...)
 ... and more

notes.title: Challenge ! Update 0.3.22
notes.content:
Challenges

The difficulty of the mode and the map gives you a chance of getting a challenge (low to high).
The challenge is linked to the player's result, not that of the group. A partially completed challenge is not rewarded.

Challenges won or lost are visible in the player's statistics.
This new feature allows you to quickly earn medals and money in addition to the contract. New players will benefit more quickly from the purchases available from the merchant.

New challenges may be added in future updates.
